lemma recolored {J} {o σ Λ E} (h : T.up.Bounds o σ E Λ) (hh : 0<R.beta)
    (C : Gaussian.Table (Rows.In x A F (G:=G))) (m : LinkArray G (Frozen A x F) → Prices G (Active A x F))
    (Y : LinkArray G (Frozen A x F)) (z : Prices G (Active A x F)) :
    prefactor S G R.beta * dyed (J:=J) T x V k A R W F D q d C m Y z = Real.exp (force C z/2) *
      regularized D A F V k q J d (garments T x V k A R) Y (displaced (m Y) (coupling R.beta) z) := by
  let g := coupling R.beta
  let a := (m Y + g • z)
  let y := tape a
  let U := physical A F V Y y
  let e := guide T x V k W A F q d Y a
  have he : fee T x V k A U = averaged (residual T x V k W A F q d Y U a) + e := by
    rw [exact_fee, compose_residual _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h]
  have ht := adjusted T x V k W A F q d Y C (m Y) z (coupling_pos hh)
  change adjustment T x V k W A F q d Y C (m Y) g z = force C z / 2 - e/g^2 at ht
  change prefactor .. * (reserve q J d y*doors q d y*D.bill A k U V*S.likelihood U k *
    exposed R (till x) U*Real.exp (-R.beta*averaged (residual T x V k W A F q d Y U a)+_)) =
      Real.exp _*((reserve q J d y*doors q d y)*((D.bill A k U V*S.likelihood U k)*garments T x V k A R U))
  have hb : e/g^2 = R.beta*e := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv,by_coupling hh]; ring
  rw [ht,hb, show -R.beta*averaged (residual T x V k W A F q d Y U a)+(force C z/2-R.beta*e)=
    force C z/2-R.beta*fee T x V k A U by rw [he]; ring,sub_eq_add_neg, Real.exp_add, ← neg_mul,garments]
  ring

proof_context.conclusion: `recolored` proves the transported-integrand identity by expanding the fee at `a = m Y + g z` (`exact_fee`, `compose_residual`), on the active coordinates `Rows.In x A F`.

lemma adjusted (C : Gaussian.Table (In (G:=G) x A F)) (m z : Prices G (Active A x F)) {g : ℝ} (hg : 0<g) :
    adjustment T x V k W A F q d Y C m g z = force C z/2 - guide T x V k W A F q d Y (m+g • z)/g^2 := by
  let L := move T x V k W A F
  let w := direct T x V k W A F q d Y m
  let v := L *ᵥ z
  have he : direct T x V k W A F q d Y (m+g • z)=w+g • v := by
    unfold direct w v L; rw [mulVec_add,mulVec_smul, direct]; abel
  have hh : gram T x V k W A F *ᵥ m + blame T x V k W A F q d Y = L.transpose *ᵥ w := by
    unfold gram blame L w direct; rw [mulVec_add,mulVec_mulVec]
  have hx (a b : Vec (In x A F (G:=G))) : ((gram T x V k W A F *ᵥ a) ⬝ᵥ b) = ((L *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (L *ᵥ a)) := by
    unfold gram L; rw [← mulVec_mulVec,dotProduct_comm,Matrix.dotProduct_transpose_mulVec,dotProduct_comm]
  unfold adjustment eta force guide
  rw [he, hh, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_comm (L.transpose *ᵥ w), Matrix.dotProduct_transpose_mulVec, sub_mulVec,
    dotProduct_sub,dotProduct_comm z (gram T x V k W A F *ᵥ z),hx]
  simp only [add_dotProduct,dotProduct_add,dotProduct_smul,smul_dotProduct,smul_eq_mul,dotProduct_comm v w]
  change -((w ⬝ᵥ w)/2)/_ + _ + _ = _
  change -((w ⬝ᵥ w)/2)/g^2 + -g⁻¹ * (w ⬝ᵥ v) + ((z ⬝ᵥ _) - (v ⬝ᵥ v))/2 =
    _ - ((w ⬝ᵥ w) + g*(w ⬝ᵥ v) + g*((w ⬝ᵥ v)+g*(v ⬝ᵥ v)))/2/g^2
  field_simp; ring

proof_context.conclusion: `adjusted` proves by expanding the quadratic that `adjustment` equals `force C z/2 - guide(m+g z)/g^2`, including the linear residual term.

lemma chartCost_eq (C : Table (ι × G.ColorIndex)) {g : ℝ} (hg : 0<g) :
    chartCost C g = g ^ Fintype.card (ι × G.ColorIndex) * coat C := by
  unfold chartCost coat Gaussian.dome
  rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity),Real.sqrt_sq hg.le,mul_comm _ g,mul_pow,mul_assoc]

proof_context.conclusion: `chartCost_eq` rewrites the prefactor as `g^n * coat C`, the determinant factor.
